scenario_description:
Objective: Use the early Blue Line and connecting route from Lake Street/Midtown to reach a Hastings courthouse assignment with the rolling interpreting kit.
Emerging Need: Station access looks usable before departure and the trip begins with a paid fare tap, but the paid-area elevator then locks, leaving the platform unreachable without station assistance.
Decision Context: Recognizing the workable recovery depends on stored station-service instructions and Jonas’s traveler details, not on the alerts alone.
Consequence: If the access stoppage is not handled before the target train leaves, the same transit attempt can no longer deliver him by the court start.

parameter.title: Hastings courthouse interpreting assignment
parameter.description: Use the 06:17 southbound Blue Line departure from Lake Street/Midtown with the rolling interpreting kit, then connect east for the courthouse arrival window.

parameter.content: Lake Street/Midtown station update: the public elevator to the southbound Blue Line platform has locked out again inside the paid area. Escalator and stairs remain available; the staff service lift is not open for passenger self-use. The 06:17 southbound departure remains on time.

Lake Street/Midtown update: the 06:17 southbound Blue Line departure has left the station. Current trip planner estimates show the next transit combination from this station reaching Dakota County Courthouse after 08:05.
